input.label: bug
input.reply:
Thanks for the repro and for bisecting across versions. Your StackBlitz links show a change in behavior between 4.0.2 and 4.0.6/4.0.11.

I couldn't search existing issues or the source from here, so I haven't checked for duplicates or a cause. Two things are unclear:

- With `isolate: false`, sharing globals between test files is expected, so this may be intended. Your report suggests 4.0.2 still gave each file a fresh `window.navigator`, so something may have changed in how the environment is set up or torn down per file.
- You mention `happy-dom` problems in 4.0.3–4.0.5. Please confirm which environment and pool you use, and whether the result is the same with `jsdom`.

Please also check whether the failure goes away with `isolate: true`, and post your full `vite.config.ts` in the issue. A maintainer will need that to decide whether this is a regression or a documented `isolate: false` limitation. I can't promise a fix.
